legal_units.text: Sl No: 2; Income Not To Be Included In Total Income: Any sum received under a life insurance policy, including the sum allocated by way of bonus on such policy.; Conditions: (a) The insurance policies, issued during the period mentioned in column B of the table below, except where such sum is received on the death of a person, under a life Insurance policy issued by, shall fulfil the conditions mentioned in column C thereof: Table columns: Sl. No.; Period of issue of insurance policy; Conditions Sl No: 1; Period Of Issue Of Insurance Policy: 1st April, 2003 to 31st March, 2012.; Conditions: Premium to sum assured ratio is ≤ 20%. Sl No: 2; Period Of Issue Of Insurance Policy: 1st April, 2012 to 31st March, 2013.; Conditions: Premium to sum assured ratio is ≤ 10%. Sl No: 3; Period Of Issue Of Insurance Policy: 1st April, 2013 to 31st January, 2021.; Conditions: Premium to sum assured ratio is ≤ 15% for special policy; and ≤ 10% for other policies. Sl No: 4; Period Of Issue Of Insurance Policy: 1st February, 2021 to 31st March, 2023.; Conditions: Unit linked insurance policy:— (A) premium to sum assured ratio is ≤ 15% for special policy; and ≤ 10% for other policies; and (B) aggregate of premium for all such policies (in any of the tax years during the term of all of such policies) is ≤ ₹ 2,50,000. Premium to sum assured ratio is ≤ 15% for special policy; and ≤ 10% for other policies. Other than unit linked insurance policy:— Sl No: 5; Period Of Issue Of Insurance Policy: On or after the 1st April, 2023.; Conditions: Unit linked insurance policy:— (a) premium to sum assured ratio is ≤ 15% for special policy; and ≤ 10% for other policies; and (b) aggregate of premium for all such policies (in any of the tax years during the term of all of such policies) ≤ ₹ 2,50,000. Other than Unit linked insurance policy:— (i) premium to sum assured ratio is ≤ 15% for special policy; and ≤ 10% for other policies; and (ii) aggregate of premium for all such policies (in any of the tax years during the term of all of such policies) is ≤ ₹ 5,00,000; (b) the conditions of aggregate premium of ₹ 2,50,000 and ₹ 5,00,000 mentioned in clause (a) shall not apply to any sum received under a life Insurance policy issued on or after the 1st April, 2025, by the International Financial Services Centre Insurance Office; (c) the following sums shall not be eligible for exclusion from total income:— (i) any sum received under section 127(4); and (ii) any sum received under a Keyman insurance policy. For removal of difficulties, the Board may issue guidelines with the previous approval of the Central Government, which shall be binding on the income-tax authorities and the assessee and every guideline issued by the Board under this clause shall be laid before each House of Parliament.

legal_units.schedule_title: INCOME NOT TO BE INCLUDED IN TOTAL INCOME
legal_units.text: Sl No: 3; Income Not To Be Included In Total Income: Any payment from a provident fund to which the Provident Funds Act, 1925 (19 of 1925) applies, or from any other provident fund set up by the Central Government and notified by it in this behalf.; Conditions: (a) The income by way of interest accrued during the tax year shall not be eligible for exclusion from total income where,— (i) it is attributable to the contribution (including aggregate thereof) made by that person on or after the 1st April, 2021; (ii) such contribution exceeds— (A) ₹ 5,00,000 in a tax year in such fund where no contribution is made by the employer of such person; (B) ₹ 2,50,000 in other cases; and (b) the amount of income not to be excluded from total income as referred to in clause (a) shall be computed in such manner, as may be prescribed.
